mechanism: Amitriptyline's anticholinergic properties and potential effects on renal potassium excretion may increase hyperkalemia risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment or those on concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; assess renal function and concurrent medications; use potassium supplementation cautiously and only when clinically indicated with baseline and periodic potassium monitoring.
